status: FROZEN construct map. Pre-registration, MDEs and decision criteria are NOT part of this artifact and come next.

C1.name: Material resources
C1.accumulated: adverse shortfall from own pre-crisis level
C1.note: pooled |r| 0.84-0.90 among members and stable across all three views: these are one construct measured five ways, so one representative

C2.name: Labour-market exclusion
C2.note: DIFFERENT REPRESENTATIVE BY ESTIMAND, declared in advance and not a post-hoc substitution within one model: LTU for the current snapshot, cumulative excess unemployment for accumulated history. Base 2009 because full-panel unemployment coverage begins there

C3.name: Loss against own past
C3.accumulated: shortfall area and duration below baseline, construction-specific
C3.note: FOUR INDIVIDUAL PRIMARIES, no primary composite: the four answer different questions. A composite is a sensitivity only -- families B, C and D each failed as composites and D produced a stable sign reversal

C4.name: Wage-adjusted affordability
C4.accumulated: persistent excess above the EU-relative benchmark, if interpretable
C4.note: r = 0.963 with work_effort_squeeze in ALL THREE views -- the same measurement twice. They may never enter a specification together

C5.name: Inflation exposure
C5.accumulated: cumulative price growth compounded from a fixed base
C5.note: SEPARATED FROM C4 on the evidence: wadj_a01 correlates 0.058/0.087/0.011 with these three pooled, and all three REVERSE SIGN between the between (+0.48/+0.64/+0.22) and within (-0.29/-0.25/-0.13) views. A price level and an inflation rate are not variants of one construct. BASE 2008: HICP has 27 reporters from 2004, so 2008 is fully covered and matches the project's dominant pre-crisis convention

C6.name: Housing pressure
C6.accumulated: cumulative excess from the earliest reliable baseline
C6.note: BASE 2010, NOT 2008: ilc_lvho07a reaches 27 reporters only from 2010 (25 in 2008-2009, 23 in 2005). A 2008 base would leave two countries without one. The departure from the project's 2008 convention is deliberate and recorded here

P1.name: Proximate material hardship
P1.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never a headline explanation. All four are EU-SILC self-reported affordability items from the same instrument as the outcome. Run to quantify how much apparent explanation is restatement

contextual_and_legacy.net_migration: contextual scarring hypothesis; causal position ambiguous (both a response to and a contributor to labour-market damage)
contextual_and_legacy.s80s20: retest of a known inequality null (claim 8.1); must be labelled a retest, never a fresh candidate
contextual_and_legacy.saving_rate: ambiguous-direction balance-sheet context; high saving may be prudence or demand collapse
contextual_and_legacy.debt_to_income: ambiguous-direction balance-sheet context; reverses sign between pooled (+0.68 with real GDP) and within (-0.65)
contextual_and_legacy.working_hours: descriptive component of the work-effort story only
contextual_and_legacy.arop_before_transfers: separate policy specification; mechanically related to AROP
contextual_and_legacy.transfer_effect: separate policy specification; definitionally AROP before minus after

testing_structure: 1. Describe every variable: levels, trajectories, ranks, all three correlation views.
2. Test the six objective constructs individually against the common baseline.
3. Sensitivity substitutions within each construct, FDR within construct.
4. The four C3 measures reported individually, FDR within C3.
5. P1 run separately as a proximity diagnostic.
6. COMBINED MODEL IS THE ALREADY-FROZEN P3 SPECIFICATION. The 15 pairwise family combinations are NOT reopened.
7. Current vs accumulated representatives compared on identical samples.
8. Between/within decomposition for any accumulated result that looks informative.
interpretation_rule: The correlation matrices identify duplication and sign reversals. They do not select variables. Correlations with the two gap outcomes are partly ARITHMETIC (the gaps contain AROP and AROPE by subtraction), and correlations with AROPE are partly DEFINITIONALLY STRUCTURED (AROPE is a union containing AROP, deprivation and low work intensity, and aggregate data do not reveal the component overlaps).
